gbm_population_evidence.quote: Solid Tumor; High-grade Glioma; Leptomeningeal Metastasis
Patient with solid tumor malignancy or high grade glioma with leptomeningeal metastasis established radiographically and/or through cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) cytology

candidate_evidence.quote: Single institution study to assess the safety of concurrent Azeliragon with craniospinal irradiation (CSI) in patients with leptomeningeal metastasis from solid tumor malignancies and high-grade gliomas.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients who are candidates for radiation therapy for the treatment of leptomeningeal metastasis

role_evidence.quote: Once the recommended dose is identified, additional patients will be treated with Azeliragon at recommended dose in combination with craniospinal irradiation (Dose Expansion).

agents.drug_class_hint: oral small-molecule RAGE (receptor for advanced glycation end products) antagonist, previously developed for Alzheimer disease
arms: Dose Determination followed by Dose Expansion

coder_notes: Glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, eligibility or arm labels; only 'high-grade glioma' and solid tumours with leptomeningeal metastasis, so high_grade_glioma_unspecified (excluded at S5). basket set true because the design is a multi-cancer (solid tumour + HGG) trial, although GBM is not explicitly eligible. Azeliragon is the only investigational drug, given with craniospinal irradiation. Treatment setting (leptomeningeal spread) not stated as recurrent/newly diagnosed. No rationale or mechanism stated in the record.
